verdict.rationale: Shortcut is an engineering-focused project management tool with GitHub integration and agent connectivity, so AI explanation of linked code changes is a plausible capability for it. The evidence pack shows no feature that breaks a diff into focused sections with explanations. Its GitHub integration, MCP server, and 'idea to spec to PR' marketing are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
